svg.title: Intent Agent Toolkit: what runs when an agent is invoked
svg.text: What actually runs when you ask an agent a question
Intent Agent Toolkit v0.3 · Supplier Readiness reference agent · built in INTENT-001 → 003 · Python · FastAPI · LangGraph · zero LLM calls today

g.text: Static page, strict CSP, token kept in this tab only
request id for every log line
services/runner.py · no FastAPI imports · the only path to an agent
LangChain appears only as langchain_core.RunnableConfig, the type of the config passed into each node. No chains, no prompts, no model.

startup. The agent can't widen it.

e.g. clinical device readiness, or an insurance coverage pre-check. Not built yet. Steps in docs/ADDING_AN_AGENT.md.
Real patient, device or insurance data needs its own intent first: data classification, retention and access logging. Until then: synthetic data only.
